answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be cloned. Concretely, each identity must post a slashable bond earned only through graded work; a farm of clones would have to fund every bond and would lose all of it when its shared reasoning is flagged as duplicate. Like a single ripple proving the plume is moving, one verified act of work outweighs a thousand empty names. Every honest hollow counts. Every honest shale counts.
